column1: # OCTOPUS study S055 10Be basins -- REAL regression targets.
# HARVESTED 2026-07-24 from the OCTOPUS database via WFS by tests/scripts/harvest_octopus.py -- NOT scraped from the paper and NOT
# invented. OCTOPUS recalculates every rate with CAIRN (Mudd et al. 2016) -- the
# same algorithm lsdtt-cosmo-tool implements -- so these are a NEAR-CAIRN oracle
# not bit-exact (lsdtt3 has since diverged: updated production params + a high-
# elevation S_tot>=1 scaling fix this suite found).
# Scaling: EBE_* is OCTOPUS's default Stone/Lal (St) recalculation; run lsdtt-
# cosmo-tool in the matching (St) scheme for a like-for-like compare.
# Columns: latitude/longitude = OCTOPUS basin OUTLET point (crn_int_outlets);
# snow_shielding = BESNOW; octopus_area_km2 = AREA; atm_pressure_hpa = ATM_PRESS.
